A sessão terminou com 4 votos a 3 para manter separadas as análises pela Corte das condutas de Moraes, na relação com Vorcaro, e de André Mendonça, na condução do relatório do caso Master. Na prática, ainda não foi definido como os casos serão julgados. 🔍 Agora, Dino tem até 90 dias corridos para liberar o caso à presidência do STF, que marcará nova data para concluir a votação da questão de ordem e seguir com o julgamento. O prazo, portanto, acaba em dezembro, na reta final dos trabalhos do Supremo neste ano. Se Dino mantiver o voto, o placar fica em 4 a 4. item.title: Florida oyster reef restoration helped marine life return within 18 months
item.description: In Florida's Indian River Lagoon, restored oyster reefs have sparked impressive marine life revitalization. Species diversity reached parity with that of thriving reefs in a mere year, while overall invertebrate abundance required eighteen months for similar recovery. Notably, flatback mud crab populations surged alongside developments in reef structures and oyster density, highlighting how environmental factors shape the resurgence of these marine communities. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Saudi Arabia released 313 gazelles and 20 years later both species thrived
item.description: A groundbreaking initiative saw the reintroduction of captive-bred sand and Arabian gazelles to Saudi Arabia's Uruq Bani Ma'arid protected area. Over two decades, camera traps documented the flourishing populations of these species. Sand gazelles exhibited seasonal movement patterns in the expansive desert, while Arabian gazelles adjusted their daily activities amid the extreme heat, showcasing an impressive long-term adaptability to their environment.
